mapper.select: /*commonMdCmBuyPriceApproval.selectBuyPriceApprList*/ SELECT TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS NO ,A.CMS_CATLG_ID ,A.BUY_INFO_ID ,A.BUY_INFO_SEQ ,A.DESCRIPTION_LOC ,A.MODEL_INFO ,A.SPECIFICATION ,A.MAKER_NAME ,A.ORDER_MEASURE ,A.AGENT ,A.AGENT_NAME ,A.RE_BUY_PRICE_VIEW ,A.CH_BUY_PRICE_VIEW ,A.RE_BUY_PRICE_RAW ,A.CH_BUY_PRICE_RAW ,A.UP_RATE ,A.CHANGE_REASON FROM ( SELECT D.CMS_CATLG_ID ,D.CMS_CATLG_ID || '-' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(D.CATLG_SEQ), 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_ID ,LPAD(TO_CHAR(D.CATLG_SEQ), 5, '0') AS BUY_INFO_SEQ /* 구매정보코드 : 화면 표기는 순번만 쓴다(상품정보코드는 옆 열에 있다) */ ,C.DESCRIPTION_LOC ,C.MODEL_INFO ,C.SPECIFICATION ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND CODE = C.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_NAME ,C.ORDER_MEASURE ,D.AGENT ,(SELECT M.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY M WHERE M.COM_CODE = D.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(D.RE_LIST_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990')) AS RE_BUY_PRICE_VIEW ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(D.CH_LIST_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990')) AS CH_BUY_PRICE_VIEW ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(D.RE_LIST_PRICE)) AS RE_BUY_PRICE_RAW ,TRIM(TO_CHAR(D.CH_LIST_PRICE)) AS CH_BUY_PRICE_RAW ,CASE WHEN NVL(D.RE_LIST_PRICE,0) = 0 THEN '' ELSE TRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND((D.CH_LIST_PRICE - D.RE_LIST_PRICE) / D.RE_LIST_PRICE * 100, 2), 'FM990.00')) || '%' END AS UP_RATE ,D.BELOW_TEXT AS CHANGE_REASON ,D.PM_SEQ FROM KEPMGPDT D, CMSCATLG C WHERE D.CMS_CATLG_ID = C.CMS_CATLG_ID AND D.BUYER = #{KEY_2} AND D.PM_NO = #{DOCU_NO} ORDER BY D.AGENT, D.PM_SEQ ) A
